title: A subdifferential characterization via Busemann functions and applications to DC optimization on Hadamard manifolds
summary: This paper investigates the properties of Busemann functions on Hadamard manifolds and their use in optimization algorithms in Riemannian settings. We present a new Busemann-based characterization of the subdifferential, which is particularly well suited to Riemannian optimization. In the classical Hadamard manifold framework, a subgradient provides a global lower model of a convex function expressed through the inverse exponential map.
